build: Forced native build with CC=gcc, MEMORY_BOOK_BUILD_NATIVE=1; actual package, backend and extension file verified from this worktree.
contracts: Small exact-project membership is applied only under the caller read snapshot and retains original project/chapter/session ownership predicates.

Current, historical, identifier, Chinese and unmatched queries preserve complete original responses including global BM25 ranks, source spans and diagnostics when compared with the original route in the same archive.
Directory totals, ties, previews and chapter pagination preserve exact original responses.
256-page complete membership is accepted when limits can be inspected; 257 pages never produce a partial filter.
Variable-budget and custom-factory cases retain the original complete statement.
Adaptive, turn and session segmentation preserve source spans and global ranks.
Warm responses retain nested mutation isolation and reject invalid arguments; external ingest invalidates cached responses.
Existing semantic model/index validation, token-budget counting, current evidence packing and snapshot tests passed.
limitations: This is a selected 134-test regression suite per backend, not the full repository suite.
Recorded test/build elapsed times are execution provenance, not a latency or throughput experiment.
No post-change speedup, constant-time retrieval, or all-scenarios improvement is established here; the unchanged formal paired matrix must measure actual effects.
The membership path avoids selected foreign page lookups but still traverses global FTS postings and uses global phrase document frequencies.
SQLite 3.53.1 and Python 3.12.14 were used locally; older Python/SQLite limits retain the guarded fallback and require existing CI coverage.
No new schema or persistent cache was introduced; RECALL_VERSION and declaration semantics were not changed by this commit.
